name: Your Simple SVG Support
author: Vladyslav Lykhenko

sections.description: Your Simple SVG Support is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows you to upload and use SVG images on your WordPress site without any complex configuration. SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) is a vector image format that ensures high-quality graphics on any screen resolution, making it perfect for logos, icons, and responsive designs.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Your Simple SVG Support”
  3. Activate Your Simple SVG Support from your Plugins page
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

  1. Simple activate Your Simple SVG Support plugin
  2. You can upload SVG images now

How to uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin.
